title: Orbit YAML document type
description: Declares how the YAML language module recognizes a document type, which keys become definitions, and which keys become imports. YAML files that match no document type emit no definitions or imports. Configs live in crates/code-graph/src/v2/langs/generic/yaml/document_types/ and are validated when the module loads them.

name.description: Document type identifier; must equal the config file stem.

keywords.description: The format's reserved root keywords. They are never author-named entries, so a 'root_keys' shape skips them.

matcher.description: A file is of this document type when its name matches a suffix or its root mapping satisfies every declared key condition.

filename_suffixes.description: Matched against the filename. A suffix that does not start with '.' only matches a whole filename, so 'Chart.yaml' never matches 'MyChart.yaml'.

filename_prefixes.description: Filename prefixes, for variant files such as 'values-prod.yaml' or 'docker-compose.override.yml'.

document_keys.description: Root-level scalar keys and the conditions their values must satisfy.

definitionRule.description: One shape of the document that becomes definitions. Exactly one shape key is set.

children_of.description: Root mapping whose child keys become definitions, e.g. 'variables' yields 'variables.RUNNER_TAG'.

items_of.description: Root sequence whose scalar items become definitions, e.g. 'stages' yields 'stages.lint'.

root_keys.description: Author-named root keys become definitions; the document type's 'keywords' are skipped. The shape for GitLab CI jobs.

value_of.description: Dotted key path whose scalar value names one definition spanning the document, e.g. 'metadata.name'.

all_keys.description: Every key at every depth becomes a definition with a dotted FQN; for path-addressed config such as Helm values.

key.description: Mapping key that carries imports, for example 'include' or 'dependencies'.

also_under.description: Parent keys the rule also applies under; without it the key only counts at the document root.

scalar_type.description: Import type emitted when the value is a scalar or a sequence of scalars.

mappingForm.description: One shape a mapping entry can take; a form applies when its path_key is present.

path_key.description: Key whose value becomes the import path.

name_keys.description: Keys whose values become import names; a sequence value emits one import per entry.

alias_key.description: Key whose value becomes the import alias, typically a pinned version or ref.

version_split.description: Single character splitting a version off the end of the path, for example '@'.
